sentence_stem: We chose the new bus because
correct_completion: it is faster than the old bus.
full_sentence: We chose the new bus because it is faster than the old bus.
acceptable_variants: it is quicker than the old bus.

options.text: it is the oldest bus in the city.
options.why_wrong: This describes age, not speed, so it does not give a comparative reason for choosing the new bus.

options.text: it is faster than the old bus.
it has the same speed as the old bus.
options.why_wrong: Equal speed gives no reason to prefer the new bus over the old one.

options.text: it is slower than the old bus.
options.why_wrong: The comparative 'slower' gives the opposite meaning, so it cannot explain why the new bus was chosen.

grammar_focus: Comparative adjectives with 'because' to give a reason
explanation: After 'because', we need a clause that gives the reason for the choice. The comparative form 'faster than' compares the two buses and explains the decision.
translation: Escolhemos o ônibus novo porque ele é mais rápido que o ônibus antigo.
